mxCell.value:
employees ---------------------- employee_id (PK, UUID) bank_id (text, indexed, RLS key) branch_id (text) employee_number (text) email (text) first_name / last_name (text) phone (text) role (text: teller/manager/officer/...) department (text) status (text: active/inactive/suspended/terminated) hire_date (date) created_at / updated_at (timestamptz)
Row-Level Security: bank_id = session context

Emits EmployeeEvent to Kafka: - employee.onboarded - employee.updated - employee.suspended - employee.terminated
Row-Level Security enforced at DB level. bank_id policy restricts cross-tenant access.
